Both hands: C major with a bass
“Both” is how you play a loop: the left hand plays
the bass note (purple, as everywhere in the app),
the right hand the chord. A slash chord like C/E
puts E in the left hand.

Not every scale is the same: in F the 4th finger
takes B♭ and the thumb tucks under onto C. Scales
come from a published table, not a rule.
Going up, the left hand runs out of fingers the
other way: 5-4-3-2-1, then the middle finger
crosses over the thumb onto A.
Decides when a chord is split between the hands.
Octave is the default: about 3 in 10 adult women
can't play an octave comfortably on a standard
keyboard, so smaller is offered too.
